# Embedded group relationship component

Source: the installed astrbot_plugin_group_relation_analyzer, version 2.1.2.
Original author: Hermes. License declared by the original metadata: MIT.

The relation statistics store, scoring signals, network metrics, presentation descriptions and optional shared sentiment adapter are reused here. Original plugin commands and plugin class are excluded. Native full-session scope keys and transactional message-id deduplication are added by ysyhlly.
